avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce dapagliflozin levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concomitant use; select alternative herbal supplement

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Cranberry Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase urinary acidification and alter SGLT2 inhibitor effectiveness; increases DKA risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; use whole cranberry cautiously

caution_supplements.name: Garlic Supplement
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet effects; additive bleeding risk if combined with other anticoagulants
caution_supplements.action: Monitor; generally safe at standard doses

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May independently lower blood glucose; potential additive hypoglycemic effect
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose closely; counsel on hypoglycemia symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Excessive Alcohol
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increases risk of euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (euDKA) and hypoglycemia with SGLT2 inhibitors
avoid_foods.action: Limit alcohol to ≤1 drink/day for women, ≤2 drinks/day for men; avoid binge drinking

caution_foods.name: High Sodium Foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase blood pressure and fluid retention; dapagliflozin may increase sodium excretion
caution_foods.action: Counsel on moderate sodium intake (<2,300 mg/day) as part of diabetes management

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit Juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor; minimal clinical significance with dapagliflozin but may slightly increase levels
caution_foods.action: Occasional consumption acceptable; counsel to maintain consistent intake if consumed

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis (nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, dyspnea) especially with acute illness, surgery, or alcohol use. Assess renal function (eGFR) regularly as dapagliflozin efficacy decreases at eGFR <45 mL/min/1.73m².
